_about: Which MCP tools a crew WORKER may be granted, per server. Only READ tools are listed: an unlisted tool is a write and is
never granted (deny by absence). `crew_spawn needs:['<server>:read']` generates the allowlist from these rows; nothing spells
'the whole server', and the `mcp` / `mcpScript` / `mcp__<server>` gateways are never granted because they dispatch to any tool.
Adding a server or tool: list its bare name (before the adapter's `<server>_` prefix) under `read` ONLY if it cannot post, send,
create, edit, delete, save, or dispatch. hubmcp `call_*_mcp` are dispatchers to other servers — gateways, not reads.
Seeded 2026-09-16 from ~/.pi/agent/mcp-cache.json (notion 44 · slack 19 · hubmcp 50 · granola 6). Refresh: mcp({ server }).

hubmcp._note: call_data_guides_mcp is the ONE call_* dispatcher listed: its server exposes exactly two docs tools (get_snowflake_query_instructions, get_data_engineering_guide; listed 2026-09-16) and HubMCP requires it before any Snowflake query. Every other call_*_mcp (incident.io, Cloudflare, browser, Firecrawl, Exa, Flashboard, Parallel) and call_integration_api (any provider's REST, incl. Slack sends and Notion creates) stay absent. Linear has no HubMCP read tool — workers use the read-only Linear key via curl (see profiles/researcher).
